name: Zul'Gurub: Bloodlord Mandokir whirls once every 25 seconds, on Ohgan's back and on foot alike
contract: The live CoA combat log of 2026-08-02 (Normal kill) shows Mandokir's (11382) Whirlwind (2118408) every
25.0-25.2 s, also in cycles where he charges nobody; with a charge target it begins as the charge lands
(tester, 2026-11-04). Since round 10 he charges only on Ohgan's back (user, 2026-11-16): a second after
he mounts, then every 25 s, so a 30 s ride holds two charge slots and the third slot falls on foot
before he mounts again 45 s after dismounting. With nobody out of melee every slot is a Whirlwind
(3 s cast), on Ohgan and on foot alike; the first round-10 draft skipped the slot on foot, so the third
Whirlwind discriminates. An older script whirled twice per 25 s cycle. The hero stands in melee in the
arena, where Ohgan arrives within seconds, and stops attacking, so there is no charge target and no gaze

steps.label: Into Mandokir's arena, 30 yards in from the entrance
CONTROL: the hero is in Zul'Gurub on Normal
CONTROL: Mandokir mounts Ohgan once he arrives
DISCRIMINATING: the first Whirlwind comes in the charge's place as he mounts
Wait past the older script's second whirlwind 8 s after the charge
DISCRIMINATING: only one Whirlwind in the first 25 s slot
the second Whirlwind comes 25 s after the first, still on Ohgan's back
CONTROL: he dismounts after the 30 s ride
DISCRIMINATING: the third Whirlwind comes 25 s after the second, on foot
CONTROL: he whirled on foot, before mounting again
CONTROL: one Whirlwind per slot, no more
